definitions.explanation: Describes someone who is genuinely honest, reliable, and morally upright in their character and actions. A straightforwardly positive term for dependable honesty.

examples.japanese: {実直|じっちょく}な{人柄|ひとがら}
{彼|かれ}は{実直|じっちょく}で{信頼|しんらい}できる。
{実直|じっちょく}に{生|い}きてきた{父|ちち}を、{私|わたし}は{尊敬|そんけい}している。
examples.english: I respect my father who has lived an honest life.

notes:
ADJECTIVE TYPE: Na-adjective. Uses な before nouns: {実直|じっちょく}な{性格|せいかく}.

ADVERBIAL FORM: {実直|じっちょく}に (honestly, sincerely)

NUANCE: {実直|じっちょく} is a straightforwardly positive term describing moral uprightness and reliability. Unlike {愚直|ぐちょく}, it has no undertone of naivety - it's pure praise for honest character.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {実直|じっちょく}な{人|ひと}/{人柄|ひとがら} (honest person/character)
- {実直|じっちょく}に{働|はたら}く (to work honestly)
- {実直|じっちょく}に{生|い}きる (to live uprightly)

RELATED WORDS:
- {正直|しょうじき} (honest - more common)
- {誠実|せいじつ} (sincere, faithful)
- {愚直|ぐちょく} (simple-minded, earnest)
- {朴訥|ぼくとつ} (simple, artless)
